plainOnly: Only for plain place/transition nets (no inhibitor arcs or immediate transitions).
noImmediate: Not available for nets with immediate transitions.
stubborn.label: Stubborn sets
stubborn.hint: Property-directed search that skips independent interleavings. Same verdict, usually far fewer states.
structural.label: Structural rules A–I
structural.hint: Shrinks the net for each formula before searching. Valid only for that formula.
